notes: This is a theoretical reinterpretation of published stellar cooling observations (white dwarfs, red giants, horizontal branch stars, SN1987A) through the lens of axion models (DFSZ and KSVZ types). The paper derives constraints on axion parameters from existing astrophysical data but does not present new experimental measurements of axions. The stellar cooling anomalies themselves were published by other authors; this work reinterprets them as possible evidence for axion interactions. Figures show preferred axion parameter regions compatible with stellar data for DFSZ I/II and KSVZ A/J models, but these are derived bounds, not direct experimental exclusions. Future experiment sensitivities (IAXO, ARIADNE) are shown as projections, not current limits.
